# Color converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/color-converter/

Convert a chosen color between HEX, RGB and HSL representations. Use the color preview to confirm the value you intend to copy.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Turn a six-digit brand HEX value into RGB for a graphic or HSL for a CSS adjustment.

## Limits and checks

The tool converts opaque sRGB colors. It does not calculate print CMYK values or preserve an alpha channel.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
